name: io.github.googlarz/proton-mail-bridge-client
description: Full-featured CLI and Claude Desktop MCP server for Proton Mail via Proton Bridge — read, search, send, draft, triage threads, manage folders and labels, save attachments, and more. Everything runs locally over Bridge's IMAP/SMTP; no third-party relay ever touches your mail.

environmentVariables.name: PROTONMAIL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Proton Bridge password (Bridge app -> account -> Mailbox details) — not your Proton account password
